title: melanthera micrantha subsp. exigua
intro: Melanthera micrantha subsp. exigua, commonly known as Exigua Melanthera, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a shrub-like plant that is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Melanthera micrantha subsp. exigua include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions such as arthritis, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines and its capacity to scavenge free radicals, and it is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
